This '''attack''' on [[Bright Sun Hill]] took place in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. In that year, the [[Raining Leaves Clan|Raining Leaves]] and the [[Broken Columns Clan|Broken Columns]] Clans came together in a [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] to unite the clans into one clan. However, after multiple [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] attacks, they moved their conclave to a hill, which was claimed by [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Dyon Stadd]] for the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], so that the Clans it could remain neutral ground for the Clans.

The two Clans merged, but at nightfall, the Nightsisters attacked the hill. The Clans' [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] took part in the battle, and those without [[The Force/Legends|"The Arts"]] used [[Spear/Legends|spears]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to protect their hilltop. The hill was also attacked by the Nightsisters' [[Rancor/Legends|Rancors]], which were controlled by the [[control web]] spell. The battle at first went badly for the members of the Bright Sun Clan as they were not well organized. Though they did severely injure a few rancors, quite a few clan members were lost or too severely hurt to participate in the battle. Ben Skywalker eventually helped the people to devise a plan that would better defend them, by acting as if the hill was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The spearmen acted like [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and held back the enemies, allowing the blasters to act like [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and concentrate fire on their assailants. The Witches then act like special weapons, such as [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], firing from deep behind their lines to help weaken the rancors. Using this technique, with the help of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] weakening the witches by using other Force [[Force power/Legends|techniques]], such as seeking the Nightsisters with the Force then killing his cousins with showers of rocks, the Bright Suns were able to repel the Nightsisters.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
